listing.description: A distinctive Berkeley Hills retreat blending mid-century character, sweeping San Francisco Bay views, and modern convenience. Behind a welcoming garden gate draped in mature grapevines, this inviting single-level home offers warmth, privacy, and a seamless connection to the outdoors. Hardwood floors, wood-beamed ceilings, expansive windows, and a striking fireplace lend timeless architectural appeal to the light-filled living and dining spaces. Three bedrooms include a primary suite with a renovated bath, complemented by a second full bathroom and a convenient powder room. Two bedrooms open onto a generous balcony with captivating San Francisco views, while a separate office offers flexibility for working from home or creative pursuits. Established gardens provide a tranquil backdrop for morning coffee, outdoor entertaining, and spectacular sunset views across the Bay. Solar power and EV charging add modern, energy-conscious convenience, while a level-in entry, one-car garage and a storage room enhance everyday ease. A rare opportunity to experience the best of Berkeley Hills living, where timeless design, captivating Bay views, and modern comforts come together in a home that feels both effortlessly sophisticated and distinctly Californian.

verdict: A view-and-character trade: an authentic 1958 post-and-beam MCM with genuine (if tree-filtered) SF Bay views, a renovated interior, solar and a gated garden entry, offered at a deliberate teaser price — $999,999 against a $1.8M sale in Nov 2021 (listed $995k then, went ~81% over ask). In exchange you accept Very High fire-zone insurance friction, a flat membrane roof of unknown age, overhead power lines, close downhill neighbors and no usable flat yard. For a solo buyer who prioritizes views, light and MCM character over lot and price certainty, it earns a look — but budget for a final number well above ask.
